mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below its 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative demand signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals expanding manufacturing output, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive supply signal.

failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative monetary signal.
